item.title: Digitakt 2 × AstroLab 37 – A Workflow Sineway Didn’t Expect
item.description: video upload by Sineway "A Digitakt 2 performance built entirely from samples of the AstroLab 37. Every synth sound in this track started on the AstroLab, then took on a new shape once chopped, pitched, and rebuilt inside the Digitakt 2. The workflow surprised me – the DT2 clicked as soon as I stopped trying to treat it like a sample-based Digitone 2 and leaned into what it really wants to be

item.description: video upload by ALM TV "Pamela's Disco syncs Eurorack modular and other compatible devices to the ‘Master’ Tempo of a PRO DJ-LINK™ Network. This enables syncing your modular to your decks for unique hybrid DJ sets.
